manifest.name: telegram_host
manifest.description: Read the current chat's recent history and save a summary

commands.name: save_summary
commands.description: Copy a short summary of the current chat to Saved Messages

source: fn summary(args, config) { let messages = host_call("telegram.history", #{limit: 5}); let text = "Recent messages:\n"; for message in messages { text += message.text + "\n"; } host_call("telegram.send_message", #{chat: "me", text: text}); #{text: "Summary saved"} }
